environment: maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-21; test harness only; pinned production source unchanged
scope: Ten matching activation/draw/optional-amount outcomes and three explicit empty-Reserve eligibility discrepancies. Both turn contexts, Hydroponics/Vaporator, one-card Reserve and controlled Beru departure during a response.
differences: GEMP requires both players to have Reserve cards before offering Stew. Native follows the specific official erratum: activation is a result, not an initiation condition.
GEMP ChooseEffectOrderEffect uses its default shortcut and never asks for ordering. Native offers the official turn-player choice when both groups can activate; comparisons choose Light first.

Pinned GEMP clamps both groups to initial Reserve counts at result start. Native attempts each mandatory activation until the current Reserve empties. Mid-sequence Reserve replenishment remains unverified against the reference.
limitations: Controlled component boards, not exhaustive whole-card or whole-match certification.
The contributor departure is a fixture intervention, not a removal card play. Native Sense, endgame and corrupted-save cases are not new reference observations.
Generic activation restrictions/replacements, activation doubling, other Beru/Owen personas and broader on-table/aboard activity rules remain unfinished. Full admission stays closed.
